contentNote: SRD 5.2.1 species and species-choice mechanics have been reorganized and converted into searchable structured data. Descriptive summaries are adapted for My RPG Source.

entries.title: Dragonborn
entries.summary: A Medium Humanoid species with a flexible breath shape, resistance tied to a chosen draconic ancestry, Darkvision, and temporary flight at level 5.
entries.description: Choose one of ten Draconic Ancestors. The choice determines the damage type for Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance. Breath Weapon can be a cone or line each time it is used.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Draconic Ancestry choices
facts.value: Black, Blue, Brass, Bronze, Copper, Gold, Green, Red, Silver, or White

traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.description: Choose a dragon ancestor. The choice determines the damage type of your Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance and can influence your appearance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.description: When you take the Attack action, replace one attack with magical energy in either a 15-foot cone or a 30-foot-long, 5-foot-wide line. Creatures in the area make a Dexterity save against DC 8 + your Constitution modifier + your proficiency bonus. A failed save takes 1d10 ancestry damage and a successful save takes half. Damage becomes 2d10 at level 5, 3d10 at level 11, and 4d10 at level 17. You can use it a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.description: You have resistance to the damage type associated with your chosen Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Draconic Flight
traits.description: At character level 5, use a bonus action to sprout spectral wings for 10 minutes, until you retract them, or until you become Incapacitated. You gain a Fly Speed equal to your Speed. Once used, this trait recharges after a long rest.

entries.title: Black Dragon Ancestry
entries.summary: This Dragonborn ancestry sets Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance to acid damage.
entries.description: Choose this option for the 2024 Dragonborn’s Draconic Ancestry trait. Breath Weapon deals acid damage, and Damage Resistance grants resistance to acid damage. The breath can be a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line each time it is used.

entries.description: Choose this option for the 2024 Dragonborn’s Draconic Ancestry trait. Breath Weapon deals lightning damage, and Damage Resistance grants resistance to lightning damage. The breath can be a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line each time it is used.

entries.description: Choose this option for the 2024 Dragonborn’s Draconic Ancestry trait. Breath Weapon deals fire damage, and Damage Resistance grants resistance to fire damage. The breath can be a 15-foot cone or 30-foot line each time it is used.

entries.title: Dwarf
entries.summary: A durable Medium Humanoid species with 120-foot Darkvision, poison resilience, extra hit points, and temporary Tremorsense through stone.
entries.description: The 2024 Dwarf has no subrace in SRD 5.2.1. Its traits are part of the species itself.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.description: You have resistance to poison damage and advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.description: Your hit point maximum increases by 1 and increases by 1 again whenever you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.description: As a bonus action while on or touching a natural or worked stone surface, gain Tremorsense with a range of 60 feet for 10 minutes. You can use this bonus action a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

entries.title: Elf
entries.summary: A Medium Humanoid species with Darkvision, charm resistance, a chosen keen-senses skill, a four-hour trance, and one of three magical lineages.
entries.description: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. The lineage supplies a level-1 benefit and spells at character levels 3 and 5. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for the lineage spells.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Speed
facts.value: 30 feet; Wood Elf lineage increases it to 35 feet

facts.label: Lineage choices
facts.value: Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf

facts.label: Free lineage spell uses
facts.value: Each level-3 and level-5 lineage spell can be cast once without a spell slot per long rest and can also use spell slots

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet; the Drow lineage increases it to 120 feet.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.description: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. Gain its level-1 benefit immediately and its listed spells at levels 3 and 5. Those spells are always prepared.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.description: Gain proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival.

traits.name: Trance
traits.description: You don’t need to sleep, magic can’t put you to sleep, and you can finish a long rest in four hours of conscious trancelike meditation.

entries.title: Drow Lineage
entries.summary: An Elven Lineage with extended Darkvision and the Dancing Lights, Faerie Fire, and Darkness spells.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Elf’s Elven Lineage trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability chosen when the lineage is selected.

facts.label: Level 1
facts.value: Darkvision increases to 120 feet; learn Dancing Lights

entries.title: High Elf Lineage
entries.summary: An Elven Lineage with a replaceable Wizard cantrip plus Detect Magic and Misty Step.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Elf’s Elven Lineage trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability chosen when the lineage is selected.

facts.label: Level 1
facts.value: Learn Prestidigitation; after a long rest, it can be replaced with another Wizard cantrip

entries.title: Wood Elf Lineage
entries.summary: An Elven Lineage with 35-foot Speed and the Druidcraft, Longstrider, and Pass without Trace spells.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Elf’s Elven Lineage trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability chosen when the lineage is selected.

facts.label: Level 1
facts.value: Speed increases to 35 feet; learn Druidcraft

entries.title: Gnome
entries.summary: A Small Humanoid species with Darkvision, advantage on all Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws, and one of two magical lineages.
entries.description: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability for spells granted by the lineage.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.description: You have advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.description: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome and gain the selected lineage’s supernatural abilities.

entries.title: Forest Gnome Lineage
entries.summary: A Gnomish Lineage with Minor Illusion and repeated slot-free Speak with Animals.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Gnome’s Gnomish Lineage trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability chosen when the lineage is selected.

facts.label: Free uses
facts.value: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

traits.name: Forest Gnome Magic
traits.description: You know Minor Illusion. Speak with Animals is always prepared; you can cast it without a spell slot a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, regaining all uses after a long rest, and you can also cast it with spell slots.

entries.title: Rock Gnome Lineage
entries.summary: A Gnomish Lineage with Mending, Prestidigitation, and temporary Tiny clockwork devices.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Gnome’s Gnomish Lineage trait. Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma is the spellcasting ability chosen when the lineage is selected.

facts.label: Device duration
facts.value: 8 hours or until dismantled with a touch as a Utilize action

traits.name: Rock Gnome Magic
traits.description: You know Mending and Prestidigitation.

traits.name: Clockwork Device
traits.description: Spend 10 minutes casting Prestidigitation to create a Tiny clockwork device with AC 5 and 1 hit point. Choose one Prestidigitation effect for the device; a creature activates it with a touch as a bonus action. You can have three devices at once. Each lasts 8 hours or until dismantled with a touch as a Utilize action.

entries.title: Goliath
entries.summary: A fast Medium Humanoid species with one reusable giant-ancestry boon, a temporary Large form at level 5, and enhanced carrying power.
entries.description: Choose one of six Giant Ancestry boons. The chosen boon can be used a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus, with all uses returning after a long rest.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Giant Ancestry choices
facts.value: Cloud, Fire, Frost, Hill, Stone, or Storm

facts.label: Giant Ancestry uses
facts.value: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.description: Choose Cloud’s Jaunt, Fire’s Burn, Frost’s Chill, Hill’s Tumble, Stone’s Endurance, or Storm’s Thunder. Use the chosen benefit a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a long rest.

traits.name: Large Form
traits.description: At character level 5, use a bonus action to become Large for 10 minutes if space permits. During the transformation, you have advantage on Strength checks and your Speed increases by 10 feet. Once used, this trait recharges after a long rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.description: You have advantage on ability checks made to end the Grappled condition and count as one size larger when determining carrying capacity.

entries.title: Cloud’s Jaunt
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Cloud Giant.
entries.description: As a bonus action, magically teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Fire’s Burn
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Fire Giant.
entries.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, deal an additional 1d10 fire damage to that target.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Frost’s Chill
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Frost Giant.
entries.description: When you hit a target with an attack roll and deal damage, deal an additional 1d6 cold damage and reduce the target’s Speed by 10 feet until the start of your next turn.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Hill’s Tumble
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Hill Giant.
entries.description: When you hit a Large or smaller creature with an attack roll and deal damage, give it the Prone condition.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Stone’s Endurance
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Stone Giant.
entries.description: When you take damage, use a reaction to roll 1d12, add your Constitution modifier, and reduce the damage by that total.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Storm’s Thunder
entries.summary: A Goliath Giant Ancestry boon associated with the Storm Giant.
entries.description: When a creature within 60 feet damages you, use a reaction to deal 1d8 thunder damage to that creature.

facts.label: Uses
facts.value: Shares the Goliath Giant Ancestry limit: Proficiency Bonus times per long rest

entries.title: Halfling
entries.summary: A Small Humanoid species with courage, exceptional luck, stealth around larger allies, and free movement through larger creatures’ spaces.
entries.description: The 2024 Halfling has no lineage or subrace in SRD 5.2.1.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

traits.name: Brave
traits.description: You have advantage on saving throws made to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.description: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you, but you can’t stop in the same space.

traits.name: Luck
traits.description: When you roll a 1 on the d20 of a D20 Test, reroll the die and use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.description: You can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

entries.title: Human
entries.summary: A flexible Humanoid species that can be Small or Medium and gains Heroic Inspiration, a chosen skill proficiency, and a chosen Origin feat.
entries.description: Human’s Skillful and Versatile traits use open choices rather than a fixed lineage table. The Codex therefore keeps those choices inside the Human entry.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Size
facts.value: Small or Medium, chosen when the species is selected

facts.label: Versatile choice
facts.value: One Origin feat; Skilled is recommended by the SRD

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.description: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a long rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.description: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.description: You gain one Origin feat of your choice. Skilled is the recommended option.

entries.title: Orc
entries.summary: A Medium Humanoid species with 120-foot Darkvision, bonus-action bursts of speed and temporary hit points, and once-per-rest refusal to fall.
entries.description: The 2024 Orc is a full species in SRD 5.2.1 and is separate from the 2014 Half-Orc.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Adrenaline Rush uses
facts.value: Proficiency Bonus times; all uses return after a short or long rest

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.description: Take the Dash action as a bonus action and gain temporary hit points equal to your proficiency bonus. You can use this trait a number of times equal to your proficiency bonus and regain all uses after a short or long rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 120 feet.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.description: When reduced to 0 hit points but not killed outright, drop to 1 hit point instead. Once used, this trait recharges after a long rest.

entries.title: Tiefling
entries.summary: A Small-or-Medium Humanoid species with Darkvision, Thaumaturgy, and one of three fiendish legacies granting resistance and innate spells.
entries.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal. The legacy grants a level-1 resistance and cantrip plus spells at levels 3 and 5. Choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma as the spellcasting ability.

facts.label: Ability Scores
facts.value: Species does not increase ability scores in the 2024 rules; Background provides the increases

facts.label: Size
facts.value: Small or Medium, chosen when the species is selected

facts.label: Free legacy spell uses
facts.value: Each level-3 and level-5 legacy spell can be cast once without a spell slot per long rest and can also use spell slots

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.description: You have Darkvision with a range of 60 feet.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.description: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal. Gain its level-1 benefit immediately and its listed spells at levels 3 and 5. Those spells are always prepared.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.description: You know Thaumaturgy. It uses the spellcasting ability chosen for Fiendish Legacy.

entries.title: Abyssal Legacy
entries.summary: A Tiefling Fiendish Legacy granting poison resistance and innate spells.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Tiefling’s Fiendish Legacy trait. You gain resistance to poison damage, learn Poison Spray, and gain Ray of Sickness at level 3 and Hold Person at level 5. The level-3 and level-5 spells are always prepared, each can be cast once without a spell slot per long rest, and they can also be cast with spell slots.

entries.title: Chthonic Legacy
entries.summary: A Tiefling Fiendish Legacy granting necrotic resistance and innate spells.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Tiefling’s Fiendish Legacy trait. You gain resistance to necrotic damage, learn Chill Touch, and gain False Life at level 3 and Ray of Enfeeblement at level 5. The level-3 and level-5 spells are always prepared, each can be cast once without a spell slot per long rest, and they can also be cast with spell slots.

entries.title: Infernal Legacy
entries.summary: A Tiefling Fiendish Legacy granting fire resistance and innate spells.
entries.description: Choose this option for the Tiefling’s Fiendish Legacy trait. You gain resistance to fire damage, learn Fire Bolt, and gain Hellish Rebuke at level 3 and Darkness at level 5. The level-3 and level-5 spells are always prepared, each can be cast once without a spell slot per long rest, and they can also be cast with spell slots.
